title: sodium issue #3871: AMD_GAME_OPTIMIZATION_BROKEN on modern AMD Graphics card with latest driver

text:
[issue by ShiriYeka]
### Bug Description

Since i updated my 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack, my latest.log says this: 

[14:20:22] [main/WARN]: Sodium has applied one or more workarounds to prevent crashes or other issues on your system: [AMD_GAME_OPTIMIZATION_BROKEN]
[14:20:22] [main/WARN]: This is not necessarily an issue, but it may result in certain features or optimizations being disabled. You can sometimes fix these issues by upgrading your graphics driver.

And i notice significant performance issues like drop from 200fps to 50fps in certain areas. 

Spark profile: https://spark.lucko.me/WxaEt9DrrV

I reported it to Xaero's World Map and it was said to me that "For some reason an OpenGL operation is very slow for you.". I have the latest 26.7.1 driver and it was installed cleanly with AMD Cleanup utility.

This performance issue did not happen before in the same 1.21.1 version, it happened since i updated my modpack and i tried to revert the Sodium and Iris version but is giving the same results, so maybe it's not completely Sodium related but the message in the latest log worries me, there is something i can do to fix this? Thank you in advance!

### Reproduction Steps

In AMD 7800 XT with latest Sodium version open the game and create a world, there is a message in the log about some incompatibilities: [AMD_GAME_OPTIMIZATION_BROKEN]

### Log File

https://mclo.gs/vkHamyF

### Crash Report

This is a random crash report from when i tried to play reverting the sodium version and i had to revert Supplementaries version too:
https://mclo.gs/Tb4VfR6

latest.log with just Sodium:

[comment by jellysquid3 (member)]
This is not a problem. This warning is shown with all versions of the Adrenalin graphics driver on Windows, and is merely informational.

See https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/issues/3318.
